messages:
rachel_prod: Dropped a new mini-mock for the Usage landing: https://www.figma.com/file/new/usage-landing-mini — question: banner-first (org total + actions) or card-grid-first (projects visible immediately)?

omar_design: Banner-first keeps billing context clear (invoices, payment method). Card-grid helps dev teams jump to project detail.

jin_eng: Banner-first is simpler for backend aggregation (one call for org totals). Card-grid needs many tails for large orgs unless we lazy-load.ontony_billing: From ops: invoices and payment details live at org. If we show projects first, add a clear label that invoices are org-scoped. Avoid users thinking projects have separate invoices.

omar_design: Proposal: banner-first with a compact project rail below showing top 6 projects + "See all". Project cards show Est. charges (pre-tax), tokens, and a kebab menu for actions.

ayla_a11y: A11y notes: 1) kebab menus must be keyboard focusable and have aria-haspopup + aria-expanded. 2) status pill text needs 4.5:1 contrast. 3) sparklines require an associated SR-only data table.

jin_eng: Implementation: project rail lazy-loads cards after banner render. Kebab actions open modal; modal will stream invoice job status for large PDFs.ontony_billing: Copy suggestions: header CTA -> 'Download org invoice (PDF)'; project action -> 'View org invoice for this project'. CSV export behind modal and RBAC.

omar_design: I'll update colors and add keyboard states. Also making the "See all" open the full project grid with a URL param (?scope=projects).achel_prod: Action items: Omar update mock + contrast, Jin add lazy-load spec + modal streaming, Tony confirm RBAC copy, Ayla smoke test a11y on next build. Design review Thursday 10:00 UTC (calendar).
